event_description: Statewide emergency for Hurricane Gloria, proclaimed on the morning of September 27, 1985 as the storm approached.

State of emergency for Hurricane Bob, in effect from 9:45 a.m. on August 19, 1991, while Lieutenant Governor Paul Cellucci was acting governor and Governor Weld was at a governors conference in Seattle.
State of emergency for all coastal counties, declared by 6:30 p.m. on October 30, 1991, as the coastal storm brought coastal flooding and high winds.
State of emergency for Middlesex and eight other counties, declared late on December 11, 1992 for heavy rain and high winds.
State of emergency for severe flooding after a weekend of heavy rain and high winds, declared by Governor Weld and Lieutenant Governor Cellucci on October 21, 1996.
State of emergency declared Sunday night, March 4, 2001, ahead of the March 5 to 7 snowstorm, forecast at 18 to 36 inches for greater Boston.
State of emergency for the January 22 to 23, 2005 blizzard, declared over the weekend, with the National Guard activated for possible coastal evacuations (dated report of January 24, 2005).
State of emergency for the October 2005 severe storms and flooding.
State of emergency for heavy rain and flooding, with the National Guard activated.
State of emergency for an ice storm with freezing rain, ice accumulation and widespread power outages.
State of emergency for heavy rainfall and river flooding on saturated ground.
State of emergency ahead of Hurricane Earl.
State of emergency for the season's first major snowstorm.
State of emergency for tornadoes and severe weather in western and central Massachusetts, including Springfield and Westfield.
State of emergency ahead of Hurricane Irene, with the National Guard mobilized.
State of emergency for the October 29 and 30, 2011 snowstorm, with the National Guard mobilized; reported October 30, 2011.
State of emergency ahead of Hurricane Sandy.
State of emergency and statewide travel ban for a blizzard with up to three feet of snow.
State of emergency and travel ban for a blizzard with heavy snow, damaging winds and coastal flooding.
